references.text: Proverbs warns against being among drunkards and gluttons, mirroring the description of the rebellious son as a 'glutton and drunkard'.
Warns against being among wine drinkers and meat eaters, linking to the description 'glutton and drunkard' in Deuteronomy.
Concerns a son who is a disgrace to his father by associating with gluttons thematically connected to the disobedient son.
Legislation regarding a stubborn son who does not obey his parents, parallel to 'sorer umoreh' - stubborn and rebellious.
Describes a son who commits violence against his father and drives his mother away, related to disobedience toward parents.
Jesus is accused of being a 'glutton and wine drinker', with a direct allusion to the wording concerning the rebellious son.
Jesus is called 'glutton and wine drinker', a reference linking his opponents' accusations to the legal text about the rebellious son.
The prodigal son squandered his inheritance in reckless living, a narrative parallel to the behavior of the rebellious son.
